# Synthetic footage image

`synthetic-footage.png` is AI-generated sample media created for local SPARQ visual verification on September 8, 2026. It is not an actual athlete, a GMTM submission, film-analysis evidence or a production fallback.

The actual-app test intercepts one exact synthetic thumbnail URL and returns this image locally with CORS enabled. It never requests that image from GMTM. The app itself only displays validated thumbnail URLs attached to its owner-scoped public film records; missing posters stay unavailable.
